title: Scout Shard — satellite task record (scout v1.0.0)
description: A finding outside the current scope that violates a materialized project rule. Self-contained task: what is wrong, where, and what to do. Validated by validate-report.mjs (forge bundle).

location.description: Where the finding lives (file path, state key, plan point...)

standard_violated.description: The rule/convention violated + its source (conventions.md §2, AGENTS.md, schema...)

evidence.description: How it shows — literal excerpt or concrete observation

suggested_action.description: What to do about it — enough for a Forge role to execute it cold

consent_level.description: Derived, never self-declared: critical OR production OR irreversible → operator. Else auto

source_awakening.description: Awakening/trigger id that produced the shard, if any

execution_ref.description: Report path produced when the shard executed (e.g. .cell/reports/implementor-SHARD-03.json)
